spec.description: Lab Core Web Vitals for one URL. Metrics use Statistic (Browsertime iteration key: min / median / p90 / max). Over time graphs always use median of that job.

spec.title: Page status
spec.description: Latest run for this URL. Same PASS / WARNING / FAIL bands as CWV Group, using the selected iteration statistic.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(lcp, 0) > 4000
      OR COALESCE(fcp, 0) > 3000
      OR COALESCE(cls, 0) > 0.25
      OR COALESCE(ttfb, 0) > 1800
      OR COALESCE(tbt, 0) > 600
    THEN 0
    WHEN COALESCE(lcp, 0) > 2500
      OR COALESCE(fcp, 0) > 1800
      OR COALESCE(cls, 0) > 0.1
      OR COALESCE(ttfb, 0) > 800
      OR COALESCE(tbt, 0) > 200
    THEN 1
    ELSE 2
  END AS "Status"
FROM (
  SELECT
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'largestContentfulPaint'->> CASE '${stat:raw}' WHEN 'min' THEN 'min' WHEN 'mean' THEN 'mean' WHEN 'median' THEN 'median' WHEN 'p10' THEN 'p10' WHEN 'p90' THEN 'p90' WHEN 'p99' THEN 'p99' WHEN 'max' THEN 'max' ELSE 'median' END)::double precision AS lcp,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'firstContentfulPaint'->> CASE '${stat:raw}' WHEN 'min' THEN 'min' WHEN 'mean' THEN 'mean' WHEN 'median' THEN 'median' WHEN 'p10' THEN 'p10' WHEN 'p90' THEN 'p90' WHEN 'p99' THEN 'p99' WHEN 'max' THEN 'max' ELSE 'median' END)::double precision AS fcp,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'pageinfo'->'cumulativeLayoutShift'->> CASE '${stat:raw}' WHEN 'min' THEN 'min' WHEN 'mean' THEN 'mean' WHEN 'median' THEN 'median' WHEN 'p10' THEN 'p10' WHEN 'p90' THEN 'p90' WHEN 'p99' THEN 'p99' WHEN 'max' THEN 'max' ELSE 'median' END)::double precision AS cls,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'timings'->'ttfb'->> CASE '${stat:raw}' WHEN 'min' THEN 'min' WHEN 'mean' THEN 'mean' WHEN 'median' THEN 'median' WHEN 'p10' THEN 'p10' WHEN 'p90' THEN 'p90' WHEN 'p99' THEN 'p99' WHEN 'max' THEN 'max' ELSE 'median' END)::double precision AS ttfb,
    (browsertime_result->0->'statistics'->'googleWebVitals'->'totalBlockingTime'->> CASE '${stat:raw}' WHEN 'min' THEN 'min' WHEN 'mean' THEN 'mean' WHEN 'median' THEN 'median' WHEN 'p10' THEN 'p10' WHEN 'p90' THEN 'p90' WHEN 'p99' THEN 'p99' WHEN 'max' THEN 'max' ELSE 'median' END)::double precision AS tbt
  FROM sitespeed_io_test_runs
  WHERE browsertime_result IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(run_date)
    AND (
      ('${device:raw}' = 'desktop' AND test_type = 'desktop')
      OR ('${device:raw}' = 'mobile' AND test_type = 'emulatedMobile')
    )
    AND (
      '${group:raw}' IN ('*', '{*}', '', 'All', '$__all')
      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(slug), ''), 'default') = ANY (string_to_array(regexp_replace('${group:raw}', '[{}]', '', 'g'), ','))
    )
    AND url = ANY (string_to_array(regexp_replace('${testname:raw}', '[{}]', '', 'g'), ','))
  ORDER BY run_date DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1

) scored
